abstract: A method has been devised that will inhibit the generation of pathological serial digital signals or other serial signals with poor statistics that adversely affect clock recovery and cable equalization. This is accomplished by adaptively dithering the least significant bit (LSB) of certain video words only when such a pattern of poor statistics would otherwise occur. LSB dither will not be visible on picture monitors. Furthermore, the dither will occur very infrequently. A complementary descrambler has been developed that will reverse the dither when it occurs. The circuitry that accomplishes these goals is simple. There is no additional time delay introduced by the improved scrambling algorithm. The primary advantage of this system is that the serial digital signal is made much more robust.
